notes: v515 — honest market sells. Until now, pressing 'Sell at market' filled instantly at the last close on your screen — a price that no longer exists by the time you can act on evening data. Buys have filled honestly at the NEXT day's open since v261, and your 🎯🛑 automatic exits always did; this closes the last gap. A market sell (full or partial) now QUEUES as a pending order and fills at the next trading day's open, gaps and slippage respected — the same price a real seller would actually get. While it waits you'll see '⏳ market sell queued' on the holding, the shares are locked so your stops and targets can't double-sell them, and you can cancel any time from ⏳ Pending orders (the shares stay put and your exits take over again). The sell form's numbers are now honestly labelled ESTIMATES at the last close; the real fill, date and P/L are recorded when it happens and your 🔔 briefing reports it. Nothing else changed: 🎯 targets and 🛑 stops remain your tools for 'sell when it reaches X' precision. Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5).
